GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: Tolerate pre-existing state['conflicts'] in SNAPSHOT loaded from disk.
Additional AC: Between T13 deployment and T14 migration completion, on-disk SNAPSHOT may still contain state['conflicts'] from the old accumulation path. process_status() must: (1) not crash when state['conflicts'] exists on load; (2) not propagate state['conflicts'] to new state writes; (3) emit no error when the key is encountered. Test: initialize state with {'status': 'open', 'conflicts': [...]} and verify process_status() runs without exception and final state has no 'conflicts' key.
